identity.name: UNIFY
identity.description: A smart campus platform that blends the authority of academia with the speed of Silicon Valley. Clean, structured, yet vibrant and alive.

rules: Overlines must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-widest
Use 'Outfit' for all main titles to give a friendly tech feel

usage: Primary Color (Electric Blue): Use for main CTAs and active states.
Accent Color (Violet): Use for 'Smart' features (AI, Analytics, Mentoring).
Background: Avoid pure black in dark mode; use Deep Navy/Slate.
Gradients: Use subtle noise textures over solid colors instead of linear gradients.

grids.dashboard: Control Room Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Dense, no gaps.
grids.social: Tetris Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12. Asymmetric, wide gaps.
grids.marketing: Swiss Grid: Overlapping elements, whitespace dominance.

cards.rule: In Dark Mode, use bg-white/5 with backdrop-blur-md and border-white/10. In Light Mode, use white with shadow-sm and border-gray-100.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:opacity-90 shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/25 transition-all duration-300

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain/noise on dark backgrounds to prevent banding.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use colored shadows (shadow-primary/20) for primary actions.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'Tracing Beam' effect for high-value cards (Mentoring, Premium features).
visual_enhancers.motion: Use framer-motion for all page transitions. Stagger children for lists.

login_hero.usage: Full height split screen on login page

universal_guidelines: Do not use Teal (#1B93A4) for dashboards.
Do not use Space Grotesk font.
Ensure Dark/Light mode toggle works perfectly.
Use 'Outfit' font for headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body.
Implement 'Glassmorphism' for overlays and sticky headers.
